title: CalibratedDataset
description: Type-safe contract for calibrated preprocessing output [KR-082]. Without this type, model pipeline does NOT accept input. Worker interface/contracts/calibrated_dataset.v1 ile birebir uyumludur.

qc_flag.description: Quality control result. FAIL = ValueError + REJECT

calibration_type.description: KR-018: NONE = HARD REJECT. G-3 (2026-06-01): ABSOLUTE eklendi (calibration_metadata + CalibrationLevel ile birleştirildi).

capability_mode.description: Determined by capability_detector.py from available bands

available_bands.description: Available spectral bands (minimum 4 MS bands required)

has_thermal.description: KR-084: Whether LWIR band is available

input_channels.description: Total channels in model input tensor (7 for BASIC, 10 for EXTENDED)
